text.text: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
For froward thoughts separate from God: and his power, when it is tried, reproveth the unwise.
He was made to reprove our thoughts.
For the corruptible body presseth down the soul, and the earthy tabernacle weigheth down the mind that museth upon many things.
And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
And set aside the thoughts that are most heavy unto thee, and haste thee to flee from these times.
Take no heaviness to heart: drive it away, and member the last end.
Their imagination of things to come, and the day of death, trouble their thoughts, and cause fear of heart;
